arStrings.szText: Whenever {c_important}Penetrating Shot{/c} damages an enemy, {c_number}[SF_39]{/c} additional arrows split off to either side. These side arrows deal {c_number}[{SF_24}*100|%x|]{/c} of {c_important}Penetrating Shot's{/c} Base damage and do not split.
{c_important}Penetrating Shot{/c} now summons {c_number}[SF_40]{/c} {c_important}Shades{/c} that also fire at your target, each dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_IMPACT_SHADE}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Penetrating Shot{/c} takes {c_number}[{SF_35}*100|%|]{/c} longer to fire, but shoots a larger, more powerful arrow dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_IMPACT}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Penetrating Shot's{/c} arrows deal {c_number}[{SF_6}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage. This bonus is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_20}*100|x%|]{/c} per enemy they pierce.
{c_important}Penetrating Shot{/c} Slows enemies hit by {c_number}[{SF_18}*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{buffduration:SIDE_2_SLOW}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Penetrating Shot{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_43} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage per stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}.
{c_important}Penetrating Shot{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_44} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage to {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemies.
